title: UE states and state transitions including inter RAT

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: UE state when no RRC connection is established. UE performs cell selection/reselection, monitors paging, and acquires system information.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: UE state when RRC connection is suspended. UE stores AS context, performs RAN-based notification area updates, and can use SDT for data transfer.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: UE state when RRC connection is established. UE can transfer unicast and MBS multicast data, performs network-controlled mobility, and provides channel feedback.

entities.name: RRC Connection Establishment
entities.description: Procedure to establish RRC connection, transitioning UE from RRC_IDLE to RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: RRC Connection Release
entities.description: Procedure to release RRC connection, transitioning UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE state.

entities.name: RRC Connection Suspend
entities.description: Procedure to suspend RRC connection, transitioning UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_INACTIVE state while storing AS context.

entities.name: RRC Connection Resume
entities.description: Procedure to resume suspended RRC connection, transitioning UE from RRC_INACTIVE to RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: Small Data Transmission
entities.description: Procedure for transferring unicast data and/or signalling over radio bearers while UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: RAN-based Notification Area Update
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE in RRC_INACTIVE state to update RAN-based notification area periodically or when moving outside configured area.

entities.name: No RRC Connection Established
entities.description: Condition where UE has no established RRC connection, placing it in RRC_IDLE state.

entities.name: RRC Connection Established
entities.description: Condition where UE has established RRC connection, placing it in either RRC_CONNECTED or RRC_INACTIVE state.

relations.description: When no RRC connection is established, UE enters RRC_IDLE state.
When RRC connection is established, UE enters RRC_CONNECTED state.
RRC Connection Establishment procedure transitions UE to RRC_CONNECTED state.
RRC Connection Release procedure transitions UE to RRC_IDLE state.
RRC Connection Suspend procedure transitions UE to RRC_INACTIVE state.
RRC Connection Resume procedure transitions UE to RRC_CONNECTED state.
UE in RRC_INACTIVE state can perform Small Data Transmission procedure.
UE in RRC_INACTIVE state performs RAN-based Notification Area Update procedure.
RRC Connection Suspend procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
RRC Connection Resume procedure requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state.
